recipes.name: Bibim Guksu - Spicy Korean Noodle Salad
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the sauce ingredients. Set aside.
Cook the noodles according to package instructions. Once done, drain, rinse under cold water, and place in a serving bowl.
Add the cabbage, cucumber, carrot, edamame, and kimchi and drizzle the sauce over top.
Give everything a good toss to coat. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Gochujang is a Korean fermented red chili paste with a sweet, savoury, and spicy flavour. It can be found in Asian grocery stores or well-stocked supermarkets. † For this recipe, I recommend using somyeon or sōmen noodles that can be found at most Asian grocery stores, though any thin wheat noodles should do. † We used an English cucumber. † Kimchi is not always plant-based as it often includes seafood-based seasonings. Vegan versions are easy to find or make at home (we’ve got a great recipe on our site!).
Storage Best enjoyed on the day it's made. Store leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
